relationships.evidence_quote: These results show that red nucleus IL-33 attends the early development of mononeuropathic pain and exerts an algesic effect.

relationships.subject: red nucleus IL-33
relationships.evidence_quote: These results show that red nucleus IL-33 facilitates the early development of mononeuropathic pain by activating JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: red nucleus IL-33
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrate that red nucleus IL-33 facilitates the early development of mononeuropathic pain by activating ERK and p38 MAPK in MAPK signaling pathway rather than JNK.

relationships.subject: red nucleus IL-33

relationships.subject: JAK2/STAT3
relationships.evidence_quote: These results display that red nucleus IL-33 facilitates the early development of mononeuropathic pain by inducing TNF-α through activating ERK, p38 MAPK, and JAK2/STAT3, but not NF-κB, signaling pathways.

key_findings: Red nucleus IL-33 and ST2 are upregulated after SNI, and IL-33 blockade attenuates while exogenous IL-33 evokes mechanical hypersensitivity.
IL-33 induces TNF-alpha via ERK, p38 MAPK and JAK2/STAT3 but not NF-kB.
